neighbours.label: The capitalized token ' Mark' as a name, more than other first names in the same slot or lower-case 'mark' words.
fire: The report was written by Mark Davies in June.
Everyone at the office likes Mark a lot.
I sent the file to Mark and Laura on Friday.
Her husband Mark teaches math at the college.
Thanks also go to Mark for the photos.
At noon Mark Thompson gave the opening talk.
Yesterday Mark called about the lease.
Our neighbor Mark fixed the fence.

notes: Other first names read 0.02-0.40 in probes, so the pole may be first-name-like at low values. 'The Mark 4 torpedo' and 'Markit' also fired (0.5), so the capitalized token matters more than the person.
